_comment: Shared case table for the runnable-scenario detector. Consumed by BOTH docs/site/tools/tests/pure.test.mjs (runnableScenario in sonda-pure.js, the browser side) and scripts/validate_docs_scenarios.py (is_runnable_scenario, the CI side). One rule decides which docs fences get a 'Run in playground' button and which fences the compile gate must prove; two implementations of it can only stay honest if they answer the same table. Add hostile cases here, never to one suite alone.

cases.name: complete scenario with scenarios: list
cases.text:
version: 2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage
    generator:
      type: sine
      amplitude: 20

cases.name: v2 shorthand: kind: header without a scenarios: list
cases.text:
version: 2
kind: runnable
name: cpu_usage
generator:
  type: constant
  value: 95.0

cases.name: generator-only fragment quoted to explain one field
cases.text:
generator:
  type: sine
  amplitude: 20
  period: 60s

cases.name: scenarios: list without version: — the engine rejects it, so it is a fragment
cases.text:
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage
    gaps:
      every: 60s
      for: 20s

cases.name: vmalert rules file
cases.text:
groups:
  - name: sonda-lab
    interval: 5s
    rules:
      - alert: CpuUsageHigh
        expr: 'cpu_usage > 80'
        for: 30s

cases.name: opted out with a first-line # sonda:static comment
cases.text:
# sonda:static
version: 2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: broken

cases.name: # sonda:static with a trailing explanation still opts out
cases.text:
# sonda:static - deliberately broken, the error message is the lesson
version: 2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: broken

cases.name: admonition-nested fence carries 4 spaces of indentation on every line
cases.text:
version: 2
    scenarios:
      - signal_type: metrics
        name: cpu_usage
        generator:
          type: constant
          value: 95.0

cases.name: nested fence that is opted out — dedent must expose the marker
cases.text:
# sonda:static
    version: 2
    scenarios:
      - signal_type: metrics
        name: broken

cases.name: UTF-8 BOM before the version line
cases.text:
﻿version: 2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage

cases.name: CRLF line endings
cases.text:
version: 2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage

cases.name: version: 2 appearing only inside a comment
cases.text:
# upgrade note: version: 2 replaced the old flat format
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage

cases.name: version: 2 appearing only inside a log message template
cases.text:
generator:
  type: log_template
  message: "config reloaded, version: 2 schema active"

cases.name: version: 2 quoted as a YAML string value elsewhere in the doc
cases.text:
kind: runnable
name: notes
note: "version: 2"

cases.name: Kubernetes manifest — kind: without a sonda version header
cases.text:
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: sonda

cases.name: docker-compose style version: 2 with no scenarios: or kind:
cases.text:
version: 2
services:
  sonda:
    image: ghcr.io/davidban77/sonda

cases.name: version: 1 is a different schema
cases.text:
version: 1
scenarios:
  - name: cpu_usage

cases.name: version: 20 must not prefix-match version: 2
cases.text:
version: 20
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage

cases.name: trailing whitespace after the version value is tolerated
cases.text:
version: 2   
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage

cases.name: version: and 2 on separate lines is not a version declaration
cases.text:
version:
2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage

cases.name: kind: nested under a mapping is not the shorthand header
cases.text:
version: 2
metadata:
  kind: Secret

cases.name: empty fence
pack-backed entry — no catalog exists in the browser or in a fence
cases.text:
version: 2
kind: runnable
scenarios:
  - pack: telegraf_snmp_interface
    signal_type: metrics

cases.name: pack: nested deeper in an entry still disqualifies
cases.text:
version: 2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage
    generator:
      type: sine
  - signal_type: metrics
    pack: node_exporter_cpu

cases.name: a metric named like a pack does not trip the pack rule
cases.text:
version: 2
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: pack_queue_depth
    generator:
      type: constant
      value: 3

cases.name: kind: composable metric pack — declares version 2 and kind:, but is a library, not a scenario
cases.text:
version: 2
kind: composable
name: telegraf_snmp_interface
metrics:
  - name: ifHCInOctets
    generator:
      type: counter
      rate_per_sec: 5000

cases.name: kind: runnable with trailing whitespace still qualifies
cases.text:
version: 2
kind: runnable  
name: cpu_usage
generator:
  type: constant
  value: 1

cases.name: kind: runnable_extra is not kind: runnable
cases.text:
version: 2
kind: runnable_extra
name: cpu_usage
generator:
  type: constant
  value: 1

cases.name: kind: composable WITH a scenarios: list still qualifies — the detector is a shape test, not a compiler; the engine rejects this combination ('composable files are pack definitions') and the compile gate is what reports it
cases.text:
version: 2
kind: composable
scenarios:
  - signal_type: metrics
    name: cpu_usage
    generator:
      type: constant
      value: 1
